subject: Request: Evidence for batched patching deviation & quarterly scan cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VM evidence request — deviation for batched patch window and quarterly cadence

Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG questionnaire we need to confirm two items from Redwood's vulnerability management program for Acme: 1) confirmation of your quarterly authenticated scanning cadence for internet-facing and internal hosts, and 2) an attestation and supporting evidence around a recent deviation we observed in June where a subset of hosts were patched in a batched window outside your usual maintenance SLO (Acme ticket 1592).

Specifically can you provide:
- Copy of the Q2 scan summary (authenticated scan) with dates and scope
- A short attestation that CVE-2026-1358 was remediated within your SLA and a remediation log for affected hosts
- Notes on why the June batched patching occurred (was this scheduled or an exception?) and any compensating controls applied during the deviation window

We need the package for an internal security review next week (target: 2026-07-08). If anything needs escalation on your side, please let me know.

Thanks,
Jordan Price
Senior InfoSec Manager — Acme Corp

Subject: Re: VM evidence request — deviation for batched patch window and quarterly cadence

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. I'll assemble the Q2 scan export and the remediation logs. Quick notes up front:
- Redwood runs authenticated internal + external scans on a quarterly cadence; our last full run completed 2026-06-14.
- The June batched patching you referenced was an approved exception related to a vendor kernel backport that required coordinated host restarts across a single availability zone; it was scheduled to reduce cross-AZ disruption and was communicated to our infra team.

I'll attach the scan summary and remediation log by EOD tomorrow and include an attestation statement for CVE-2026-1358. If Acme's review needs an engineer-to-engineer call, we can set up a 30-minute slot.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
